name: rabble-nebula
description: Entropy-driven embeddable JS rendering engine for the RaBbLE ecosystem

scripts.build: npm run build:iife && npm run build:esm
scripts.build:iife: npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=NeBuLA --external:three --outfile=dist/nebula.iife.js --minify --banner:js="/*! NeBuLA $npm_package_version+$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo nogit) */"
scripts.build:esm: npx esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --external:three --outfile=dist/nebula.esm.js --minify --banner:js="/*! NeBuLA $npm_package_version+$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo nogit) */"
scripts.build:versioned: VERSION=${npm_config_version:-v$npm_package_version} && npm run build && mkdir -p dist/$VERSION && cp dist/nebula.iife.js dist/nebula.iife.js.map dist/nebula.esm.js dist/$VERSION/ 2>/dev/null; echo "Built → dist/$VERSION/"
